rival_explanations: Narrower previous-token head: it fires only on the token immediately after '/', '-' or an adjective, with no sensitivity to distant licensors, so 'to'/'for' after 'from' or 'it is ADJ' several tokens back should not fire.
Generic function-word head: it fires equally on any predictable function word or punctuation, so 'and', 'or' or '+' in the same slots should fire just as strongly as 'to', 'for', 'with' or '/'.
